lines.t: My God, my God, You are holy! Oh my Redeemer, my beloved Savior, YahuShua, by Your blood am I washed from sin’s raiment, which had clothed me in death.

By Your sacrifice You freed me, Your great love has broken my bonds. Behold, a new light has appeared where once there was only darkness, the flame which flickered burns bright once again, for in my heart You have kindled a fire!
And Your words, Lord, Your beautiful words, they are truly a lamp for my feet.
And by following Your teaching, I have begun to unleaven my life; though by Your sacrifice, You have already freed me from the power of sin.
O Lord, YOU are my righteousness! I will obey Your Word!
O Lord, YOU are my righteousness! I will obey Your Word!
O Lord, YOU are my righteousness! I will obey Your Word!
O Lord, YOU are my righteousness! I will obey Your Word!
And though I stumble, I will not cease from striving to obey; I want to do what is pleasing in Your sight; help me walk in Your ways.
O Lord, YOU are my righteousness! I will obey Your Word!
